positions.title: Senior Product Support Engineer
positions.description:
Fully dedicated to supporting internal customers with PI Data Archive issues requiring advanced troubleshooting, including in depth source code analysis, issue reproduction, dump analysis, and live debugging. 

Author work items and collaborate with development team to provide insight into customer experience and maintain and prioritize backlog. 

Teach internal classes and develop learning material to upskill newer engineers on advanced topics.

positions.title: Product Support Engineer II
positions.description: Specialized in PI Data Archive data historian, continue directly interfacing with external customers to solve technical issues, and support internal frontline engineers with issues requiring escalation support in the PI Data Archive family of products.

positions.title: Customer Support Engineer
positions.description:
Directly interface with customers to solve in-depth technical issues. 

Perform both on-site and remote Field Service activities to upgrade/migrate components of PI System software architecture.

positions.title: Discovery Learning Apprentice
positions.description: Atmospheric research pertaining to lightning and climate patterns, compiled records, statistical analysis in MATLAB

positions.title: Physics Tutor
positions.description: Assist students with homework, exam preparation, etc. Mentor students with regards to general academic skills and habits.

honors.title: Magna Cum Laude Honor
honors.issuer: Issued by University of Colorado at Boulder · Aug 2014
